preserve: Source instruction4 says single felony; PartTwo fourth printed statement says single misdemeanor. Both original texts are retained facts, not erased history.

findings.actualDefect: Current packet p13 presents an exclusion for any felony or misdemeanor arrest/conviction during a five-year lookback on this single-felony route.
